results.name: Flood in Croatia
results.reason: On the 25 September 2024 at 12:00, top of the water wave is expected to enter in Croatia. Water level rise is predicted in the Danube basin from Hungary to Croatia. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide an initial rough estimation, flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
results.activator: Croatia|National Protection and Rescue Directorate in the Civil Protection Sector
